chunks: Ali narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar:

I said: A neighbor of mine married a woman, and when he wanted to have intercourse with her, she kicked him with her foot, and his testicle was ruptured, so he became afflicted with swelling. After that, he would have intercourse but no child would be born to him. So I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about that, and about a man who struck another man’s navel and ruptured it, and he عليه السلام said: “In every rupture, there is one-third of the diyah.”

key_terms.آدَرَ: afflicted with swelling in the testicle
key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: financial compensation paid for bodily injury
key_terms.بَيْضَتُهُ: his testicle, referring to the injured organ
key_terms.ثُلُثُ: one-third as a specified legal proportion
key_terms.فَتْقٍ: a rupture or tearing injury in the body

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for a bodily rupture in Shia hadith law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury that causes a rupture. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that for every such rupture, the compensation is one-third of the diyah, indicating a fixed rule in the law of bodily injuries.
